canonical_title: Flight path response to collective controller

versions.title_at_revision: Flight path response to collective controller
versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle's flight path response to collective inputs in forward flight (greater than 45 KGS) are no worse than Level 2 flying qualities as specified in MIL-DTL-32742 Flight Path Response to Collective Controller (Backside) paragraph, unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the flight path response to collective inputs in forward flight as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Flight Path Control and Flight Path Response to Collective Controller (Backside) paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the flight path response to collective inputs in forward flight as specified in MIL-DTL-32742 Flight Path Control and Flight Path Response to Collective Controller (Backside) paragraphs for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the flight path response to collective inputs in forward flight as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Flight Path Control and Flight Path Response to Collective Controller (Backside) paragraphs for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
